verified_working_baseline.scope: Observed snapshot on 2026-10-27; do not assume this remains the active installed baseline later.

outcome.business_goal: Pixelkiez diagnoses and explains not only defects but evidence-backed opportunities for better technical, visual and customer-journey quality, prioritized according to the business model and applicable approved industry standards/priors, with an illustrative detail when it genuinely helps the customer understand diagnostic depth.
outcome.north_star: Find the specific, supportable gap between the website's actual customer journey and the business goal; never confuse a plausible improvement with proven commercial success.
outcome.non_goals: No new website quality score; no new 49th Core metric; no fabricated branch averages, premium claim, revenue forecast, competitor comparison, irreversible browser action, or rewrite of the seven-ish-page branded PDF structure.

integration_policy.strategy: Use exact additive anchors and structured JSON patches on matching current baseline. For previous VibeCheck03 overlay apply semantic three-way merge; preserve all unaffected existing files. New ranking logic belongs in a small standalone module, optional context and existing customer-selection code path. Do not create a second score or website crawler.
integration_policy.tools: Use local deterministic file reading, editing, validation and packaging tools only when actually available and authorized. Never assume availability of live browser, PXAPI or paid market benchmark tools.

validation_matrix.case: No context: old versus new selection outputs byte-equivalent.
Approved applicable profile: category priorities affect tie-order within severity.
Owner-confirmed goal with approved goal weights: explicit bounded change logged.
Unverified goal, wrong source, duplicate/expired/conflicting profile: reject or neutral fallback.
Mandatory legal provider-identity risk remains lever 1; critical/high safety preserved.
Premium/precision role requires matching finding and evidence reference; technical and visual cues neither invent outcomes nor displace safety.
No invented averages, sector benchmarks, peer superiority, lead/conversion/revenue changes.
48 core IDs, registry weights, compute_score SHA and golden score outputs unchanged.
VibeCheck03 static/404/browser cases and safety negative tests, full PDF/report suite, legal and ElevenLabs regression.
Changed SKILL.md is complete and valid; reference links and build/admission data traceable; second patch application idempotent.
Final release and external evaluator review all refer to same artifact hash.

stop_conditions.item: Current installed baseline differs materially and no conflict-aware reconciliation is possible.
A new comparator/industry weight lacks a verified accepted source or an explicit product-policy owner.
Any core score/coverage/metric weight, mandatory legal priority, or customer truth gate changes without separate authorization.
Unsafe collector/browser/network action, injection, PDF/report metadata leakage, failed or timed-out deterministic hard test.
Previously incomplete VibeCheck03 requirements remain open when a release ZIP is requested.
Independent evaluator or same-digest release evidence unavailable: report PATCH_IMPLEMENTED_RELEASE_BLOCKED, do not create skill.zip.

enterprise_skill_patch_order.rollback: Retain untouched 338-file original baseline, previous partial patch archive, exact source hash and change manifest. Rollback restores previous installed artifact; no mutation of PXAPI, Jira, Confluence, GitHub or public websites.
enterprise_skill_patch_order.required_output: Deliver complete updated SKILL.md and all changed/added artifacts; requirement-to-test trace, full preservation diff, executed gates and failed/missing evidence, business prioritization examples, internal/customer report results and final status. If and only if the release gates pass, produce installable skill.zip. Otherwise provide a clearly labeled candidate ZIP and remaining blocker list.
